meaning: Stable Reel code/title used as the projection identity.
null_semantics: Required for a row.
permissible_inference: Stable identity only; not a performance claim.

meaning: Signal release identifier bound to this row.
null_semantics: Required for provenance.
permissible_inference: Binds the row to one immutable release; does not make values current beyond its snapshot.

meaning: Source account username.
null_semantics: Null means source identity was unavailable.
permissible_inference: Groups rows for account-level summaries; not identity verification beyond the source export.

meaning: Canonical public Reel URL captured in the export.
null_semantics: Null means no URL was supplied.
permissible_inference: Locator/provenance only; URL availability is not media or rights proof.

meaning: Date associated with the source metric snapshot.
null_semantics: Required for release rows.
permissible_inference: Dates rows to one snapshot; not an exact capture timestamp.

meaning: Observed play/view counter.
null_semantics: Observed value only; null is unknown, not zero.
permissible_inference: Describes the recorded snapshot counter; does not prove reach, audience or exposure horizon.

meaning: Observed like counter.
null_semantics: Observed value only; null is unknown, not zero.
permissible_inference: Describes the recorded snapshot counter; no causal engagement conclusion.

meaning: Observed comment counter.
null_semantics: Observed value only; null is unknown, not zero.
permissible_inference: Describes the recorded snapshot counter; no sentiment or demand conclusion.

meaning: Observed reshare counter under source semantics.
null_semantics: Observed value only; null is unknown, not zero.
permissible_inference: Keep separate from saves/sends unless provider semantics are documented.

meaning: Observed save counter.
null_semantics: Null means save count was not observed; zero means observed zero.
permissible_inference: Can support missingness-aware descriptive rates; not an assumed zero.

meaning: Source duration of the Reel.
null_semantics: Null means duration was not observed.
permissible_inference: Describes source duration only; not retention or watch-time evidence.

meaning: Source publication timestamp.
units_formula_denominator: UTC ISO timestamp; age control uses date difference to Snapshot.
null_semantics: Null means publication time was not observed.
permissible_inference: Supports an age-to-snapshot calculation; not exact exposure age or recency causality.

meaning: Numeric/exposure eligibility gate in the Signal release.
units_formula_denominator: PASS/FAIL state; denominator is the release row set.
null_semantics: Unknown means gate could not be evaluated.
permissible_inference: Defines analysis eligibility only; does not mean content quality or final selection.

meaning: Views relative to the account baseline median.
units_formula_denominator: Views / account median views; account baseline denominator.
null_semantics: Null means account baseline or valid views was unavailable.
permissible_inference: Snapshot diagnostic relative to this account baseline; not normalized historical reach.

meaning: Equal-weight robust diagnostic across available component rates.
units_formula_denominator: Robust-z component aggregation; component denominator is available components.
null_semantics: Null means insufficient component coverage or invalid metrics.
permissible_inference: Review queue diagnostic only; not a probability, causal effect or final Best score.

meaning: Number of non-null within-account robust-z diagnostic components after exposure eligibility and per-component baseline-support gates.
units_formula_denominator: Integer 0–5: count available robust z scores for log1p(Views), Likes/Views*1000, Comments/Views*1000, Reshares/Views*1000 and Saves/Views*1000. Each baseline uses eligible account rows with that component observed and must meet minimum_baseline_n. Robust scales use configured MAD floors and clipping; View index is not a component.
null_semantics: Zero means no component survives the gates, even when display metrics are populated. The engine always supplies this count; null in Notion means missing projection data. A partial count can reflect missing inputs or insufficient per-component support.
permissible_inference: Coverage of gated diagnostic z components only; not count of populated columns, final quality, significance or causal performance.

meaning: Number of account rows used to form the author baseline.
units_formula_denominator: Count; baseline eligibility floor is implementation-defined.
null_semantics: Null means baseline was unavailable.
permissible_inference: Describes baseline support; does not establish independent replication.

meaning: Transcript evidence observation state.
units_formula_denominator: Enum such as NOT_ATTEMPTED or PARTIAL; denominator is Reel rows.
null_semantics: Null means no state was projected.
permissible_inference: Evidence coverage state only; PARTIAL is not verified speech.

meaning: Legacy source-ASR metadata word count when supplied; not recomputed lexical analysis.
units_formula_denominator: Word count; denominator transcript records with a supplied legacy ASR count.
null_semantics: Null covers missing or legacy-empty source ASR count after staged falsy-to-null normalization; inspect Transcript/Text evidence to distinguish.
permissible_inference: Source metadata coverage only; does not prove speech accuracy, language, or recomputed lexical text.

meaning: Frame/source-media evidence state.
null_semantics: Null means state was not projected.
permissible_inference: Evidence state only; does not prove decoded media or scene content.

meaning: Frame attempt/observation state.
null_semantics: Null means state was not projected.
permissible_inference: Separates attempted/observed frame evidence from missing media.

meaning: Final-Best decision field retained by the projection.
units_formula_denominator: Decision enum; denominator is reviewed eligible rows only.
null_semantics: UNKNOWN means the gate is unresolved; it is not false.
permissible_inference: Do not infer a Best Reel from a diagnostic rank or UNKNOWN state.

meaning: Reason code explaining the Final Best gate state.
null_semantics: Null means no reason was supplied.
permissible_inference: Explains gate status only; not an editorial claim without review.

meaning: Like rate normalized to recorded views.
null_semantics: Null when Views <= 0, Likes unavailable, or frozen release eligibility/numeric/quarantine gates suppress the derived rate; zero means observed zero Likes with valid positive Views.
permissible_inference: Descriptive snapshot rate only.

meaning: Comment rate normalized to recorded views.
null_semantics: Null when Views <= 0, Comments unavailable, or frozen release eligibility/numeric/quarantine gates suppress the derived rate; zero means observed zero Comments with valid positive Views.
permissible_inference: Descriptive snapshot rate only; not sentiment or conversion.

meaning: Reshare rate normalized to recorded views.
null_semantics: Null when Views <= 0, Reshares unavailable, or frozen release eligibility/numeric/quarantine gates suppress the derived rate; zero means observed zero Reshares with valid positive Views.
permissible_inference: Descriptive snapshot rate only; native semantics remain separate.

meaning: Save rate normalized to recorded views.
null_semantics: Null when Saves or Views is unknown/invalid, or frozen release eligibility/numeric/quarantine gates suppress the derived rate; zero means observed zero Saves with valid positive Views.
permissible_inference: Descriptive snapshot rate only; never zero-impute missing Saves.

meaning: Conflict/impossibility reason that quarantines a row or field.
units_formula_denominator: Coded reason; denominator is affected rows.
null_semantics: Empty means no quarantine reason recorded.
permissible_inference: Signals data quality handling; does not identify the winning source value.

meaning: Observed/missing state for Saves.
null_semantics: MISSING is explicit unknown; OBSERVED includes zero.
permissible_inference: Supports missingness-aware analysis; no imputation.

meaning: Maker-coded M2 relevance candidate for available transcript text.
units_formula_denominator: Enum core/adjacent/excluded/unknown; denominator is transcript records.
null_semantics: unknown means not classified or no usable text.
permissible_inference: Maker-coded candidate; unreviewed labels do not support prevalence or causal claims.

meaning: Maker-coded opening/hook orientation candidate.
units_formula_denominator: Categorical label; denominator is word-bearing transcript records.
null_semantics: unknown/empty means not classified.
permissible_inference: Maker-coded candidate; unreviewed labels do not support prevalence or causal claims.

meaning: Lexical word count projected from transcript analysis.
units_formula_denominator: Word count; denominator records with analyzed text.
null_semantics: Null covers missing or legacy-empty transcript analysis after staged falsy-to-null normalization; inspect Transcript/Text evidence to distinguish.
permissible_inference: Supports text-length description only; not audio validity, original language, or scene timing.

meaning: Reference to the local transcript-analysis record.
null_semantics: Null means no linked text evidence.
permissible_inference: Provides lineage; does not independently verify the text.

meaning: Review state for transcript text coding.
units_formula_denominator: Enum; denominator is analyzed transcript rows.
null_semantics: Null means no review state supplied.
permissible_inference: Separates maker coding from independent acceptance.

meaning: Stable account username/title.
null_semantics: Required for an account row.
permissible_inference: Account grouping identity within the source export only.

meaning: Signal release identifier.
null_semantics: Required for provenance.
permissible_inference: Binds the account summary to one immutable release.

meaning: Metric snapshot date.
null_semantics: Required for dated summary.
permissible_inference: Dates the summary; not an exact capture timestamp.

meaning: Number of Reel rows associated with the account.
null_semantics: Null means count unavailable.
permissible_inference: Describes source corpus composition; not account audience size.

meaning: Number of source observations associated with the account.
null_semantics: Null means count unavailable.
permissible_inference: Describes source-row coverage; duplicates/conflicts remain separate in the ledger.

meaning: Number of eligible Reel rows for the account.
units_formula_denominator: Count; denominator Reels for the account.
null_semantics: Null means eligibility summary unavailable.
permissible_inference: Describes release gate coverage; not content quality.

meaning: Profile follower counter at export time.
null_semantics: Null means profile counter unavailable.
permissible_inference: Snapshot profile context only; not historical audience exposure.

meaning: Account median Reel views used by the author baseline.
units_formula_denominator: Views count; denominator account Reel rows included in baseline.
null_semantics: Null means baseline unavailable.
permissible_inference: Account-relative context; not a stable audience estimate.

meaning: Number of account rows included in the baseline.
null_semantics: Null means baseline unavailable.
permissible_inference: Indicates baseline support only.

meaning: Count of rows passing the release diagnostic hit rule.
null_semantics: Null means hit diagnostic unavailable.
permissible_inference: Snapshot diagnostic fraction only; not viral probability or success rate.

meaning: Rows eligible for the account hit diagnostic.
null_semantics: Null means hit diagnostic unavailable.
permissible_inference: Defines the diagnostic denominator; does not prove representative performance.

meaning: Hit count divided by hit denominator.
units_formula_denominator: Hit count / Hit denominator; denominator Hit denominator.
null_semantics: Null when denominator is zero/unknown or the frozen account minimum-support gate yields Hit state=INSUFFICIENT_N; zero is an observed fraction only when the gate is met.
permissible_inference: Descriptive snapshot diagnostic only.

meaning: Lower Wilson interval bound for Hit fraction.
units_formula_denominator: Wilson binomial interval; denominator Hit denominator.
null_semantics: Null when the denominator is zero/unknown or the frozen account minimum-support gate yields Hit state=INSUFFICIENT_N.
permissible_inference: Uncertainty for the diagnostic fraction under its stated approximation; not causal uncertainty.

meaning: Upper Wilson interval bound for Hit fraction.
units_formula_denominator: Wilson binomial interval; denominator Hit denominator.
null_semantics: Null when the denominator is zero/unknown or the frozen account minimum-support gate yields Hit state=INSUFFICIENT_N.
permissible_inference: Uncertainty for the diagnostic fraction under its stated approximation; not causal uncertainty.

meaning: State/reason for whether account hit statistics are interpretable.
null_semantics: Null means state unavailable.
permissible_inference: Coverage/status only; not a final account ranking.

meaning: Count of eligible Reels associated with the account for transcript evidence.
units_formula_denominator: Count; denominator eligible Reel rows for the account.
null_semantics: Null means eligibility or transcript-evidence summary is unavailable.
permissible_inference: Describes sparse transcript-evidence coverage among eligible Reels; not transcript prevalence.

meaning: Count of eligible frame sets associated with the account.
null_semantics: Null means frame evidence unavailable.
permissible_inference: Describes frame coverage only; zero does not prove no frames exist.

meaning: Local/projection review candidate link.
null_semantics: Null means no review link supplied.
permissible_inference: Navigation only; link presence is not review acceptance.

meaning: Account-level Final-Best decision state.
units_formula_denominator: Decision enum; denominator reviewed account rows.
null_semantics: UNKNOWN means unresolved gate.
permissible_inference: Do not infer account quality from an UNKNOWN or diagnostic state.

meaning: Account-level Best gate reason.
null_semantics: Null means no reason supplied.
permissible_inference: Explains account gate status only.

meaning: Card identity and human-readable title.
null_semantics: Required card identity.
permissible_inference: Identifies a draft card; does not imply selection or publication.

meaning: Editorial format label.
null_semantics: Null means format not supplied.
permissible_inference: Describes intended editorial form only.

meaning: Owner-controlled card workflow state.
null_semantics: Null means owner state not supplied; do not infer a default.
permissible_inference: Preserve as owner input; Proposed is not approval or publication.

meaning: Owner-controlled presenter/on-camera assignment.
null_semantics: Null means owner has not assigned a presenter; never invent a Lead.
permissible_inference: Only records the owner choice; it does not prove footage or consent.

meaning: Owner-controlled priority within a format.
units_formula_denominator: Ordinal number; 1 is strongest of its format; no denominator.
null_semantics: Null means owner has not prioritized the card; never invent a number.
permissible_inference: Preserve as an owner ordering signal only; not a performance score.

meaning: Original author attribution for the card.
null_semantics: For these corpus-synthesis cards use `M2 Lab — original editorial hypothesis`; null only if attribution is unknown.
permissible_inference: Attribution/ownership context; does not imply competitor authorship or source copying.

meaning: Source reference URL when a card is directly built from one source.
null_semantics: Null is correct for corpus-synthesis explanatory bodies; never invent a source URL.
permissible_inference: A locator only; null means the card synthesizes multiple functions or has no approved source.

meaning: Evidence/provenance and limitation summary attached to the card.
null_semantics: Null means no signal summary supplied.
permissible_inference: Context for review; does not make a candidate a final Best or validated script.

meaning: Days old when a radar candidate was proposed.
units_formula_denominator: Days; publication-to-pickup date difference; no denominator.
null_semantics: Null is required when pickup date is not known; do not invent a number for original cards.
permissible_inference: Only describes a dated radar pickup; not audience age or content quality.

meaning: Candidate views relative to the author median.
units_formula_denominator: Ratio; Views / author median views; denominator author median views.
null_semantics: Null is required when no matched author norm exists; do not invent a number for original cards.
permissible_inference: Snapshot diagnostic context only; not a causal or viral score.

meaning: Run/date associated with card creation or pickup.
null_semantics: Use 2026-09-05 only when draft creation date is known; null otherwise.
permissible_inference: Dates the draft/projection run; does not prove publication or activity.
